topIndia.title: The festive sales playbook: How Amazon and Flipkart are winning India’s mega sales
topIndia.summary: India’s festive sale showdown sees Amazon and Flipkart racing to dominate non-metro markets, relying on instant quick-commerce deliveries, no-cost financing, and targeted AI tools to turn record traffic into sales.
